code: Ontario Building Code 2024, Supplementary Standard SB-10 (Energy Efficiency Requirements)

structure.division_3: Default for all buildings. Choose ONE reference standard (Art. 1.1.2.1.(1)): (a) ASHRAE 90.1-2013 + SB-10 Chapter 2; (b) NECB 2015 + SB-10 Chapter 3; (c) ASHRAE 189.1-2014 Section 7 only. Within 90.1: prescriptive Sections 5-10 or performance Section 11 (Energy Cost Budget). Within NECB: prescriptive/trade-off or Part 8 performance.
structure.division_5: Simplified prescriptive division, available only where the building or part is within Part 9, contains no residential occupancy, does not use electric space heating, and is occupied on a continuing basis through the winter. If fenestration exceeds 40% of wall area or skylights exceed 3% of ceiling area, the envelope must comply with Division 3 instead.
structure.part_9_residential: Part 9 buildings of residential occupancy are excepted from SB-10 Division 3 (Art. 1.2.1.1.(1)(a)) - houses follow OBC Subsection 12.2.2 / SB-12, not SB-10.
structure.existing_buildings: Change of use and renovation route through OBC Part 10 / Part 11, outside these SB-10 paths.
structure.target: Division 3 paths target on average a 13% improvement over the 2012 OBC efficiency level (Sentence 12.2.1.1.(2) as it read Dec 31, 2024).

overlays_on_every_division_3_path.co2e_cap_art_1_1_2_2: Annual CO2e emissions shall not exceed the level achieved by the prescriptive baseline of the chosen standard.
overlays_on_every_division_3_path.peak_electric_demand_cap_art_1_1_2_3: Peak electric demand shall not exceed the prescriptive-baseline level; deemed to comply where the listed prescriptive equipment and lighting-power requirements are met.

division_3_table_1_3_1_1.note: HDD18 from SB-1 Table 2. Where electric space heating is used, the envelope shall comply with the Zone 7 table (SB 5.5-7) regardless of location (90.1 path).

division_5_hvac_anchors: Air economizer required where cooling capacity is 15.8 kW or more.
Heat recovery ventilator with at least 55% recovery effectiveness where outdoor air exceeds 1400 L/s or the system operates 8000 h/yr or more (subject to the 75% exhaust exception).
7-day time-clock controls with setback to 13 C and setup to 32 C.
Vertical fenestration VT/SHGC ratio not less than 1.10.

division_3_zone_5_table_SB_5_5_5_2017_op.element: Walls above grade - wood-framed and other

not_reproduced: Zone 6 and Zone 7 values in Tables SB 5.5-6/7-2017 and the NECB-path prescriptive tables exist in SB-10 but were not extracted in this pass; the tool reports the Zone 5 table and says so, rather than inventing the other zones.
